# Disco Lemonade Studio

> Private, one-chair hair color studio in Leonardtown, Maryland (St. Mary's County, Southern Maryland), run by hairstylist Mickayla Ramsey. Specializing in vivids and rainbows. Every new client starts with a free consultation by text.

## Contact
- Phone (text first, call second): (240) 561-8519
- New clients: text the word CONSULTATION to (240) 561-8519
- Address: 26011 Point Lookout Rd #3, Leonardtown, Maryland 20650
- Hours: by appointment
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/the__chaospixie/ (@the__chaospixie)
- Gift cards: https://squareup.com/gift/C8NTNQN8RN9TG/order

## Services
- Vivid and rainbow color, color melts
- High-contrast panels and peekaboos, color blocking
- Blonding, including bright "Barbie" blondes and silver
- Lived-in dimensional color and balayage ("vanilla" hair), reds and coppers
- Color corrections and big transformations
- Shags and shullets (shag plus mullet cuts)
- Hair gems ("sparkly things")
- Complimentary consultation for every new client

## How booking works
1. Text CONSULTATION to (240) 561-8519, or use the planner on the website.
2. Free consultation: share your hair history and inspiration. Mickayla maps out the plan, timing and price.
3. Color day.

## Good to know
- Pricing is quoted at the consultation. No prices are published.
- Big transformations have run 6 to 9 hours.
- Vivid care: wash in cold water, wash less often, use heat protectant every time, turn hot tools down.
- She also does natural ("vanilla") color, not only vivids.
- Color lines she uses in her formulas include Danger Jones, Pravana, Joico Color Intensity, Moroccanoil and K18.
- Areas served: Leonardtown, St. Mary's County and Southern Maryland.
